verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents automatic syncing of verification codes once Authenticator is connected to Password Manager, so codes you add or edit stay synchronized across the Bitwarden apps. The integrated vault authenticator generates TOTPs from the synced vault. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms simultaneous availability on phone, tablet and computer, and sync must be activated first. missing for 10: explicit documentation of simultaneous multi-device (phone/tablet/desktop) TOTP availability, independent hands-on corroboration of reliable automatic cross-device sync.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Connect Authenticator with Password Manager to sync your verification codes. Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs), six-digit codes using SHA-1 that rotate every 30 seconds
